messages:
maria_garcia: Heads up — CloudStack livestream is T-10 days. Need final confirmations on speaker lineup, demo failover plan, and swag shipment ETA.

samir: I can confirm Cloud Marketplace integration will have a short announcement (1 slide + 30s talking points). Will be on stage for the panel.

jess: Demo owners: @kevin_ops and I will run the hybrid lab (local + cloud fallback). Need hardware partner to confirm rack kit contents and serials for customs.

partner_hw_contact: Shipping manifest shared in Drive: https://rwd.co/cloudstack-manifest. Main kit = SILVA-VM-3 (x2), power strips, dongles. ETA to NYC warehouse: Fri EOD. Tracking: LP123456789US.

maria_garcia: Perfect — add that tracking to ops doc. Jess, can you paste the list of commands we'll run for the demo? Keep them short, first block is the graceful failover.

jess: Sure, demo runbook snippet:
```
# start local model
./start_inference --model redwood-lite --port 8080
# run smoke test
curl -s http://localhost:8080/health
# trigger fallback to hosted
./switch_route --policy fallback-hosted
``` 
We'll use quantized variant as faster fallback.

kevin_ops: Note: the hosted model endpoint needs rate-limit bump during rehearsals. @deploy-bot can you schedule a burst window for 3 rehearsals next Wed?

deploy-bot: scheduled: burst-window for redwood-hosted endpoints on 2026-04-01 09:00-12:00 UTC. ID: bw-2103.

samir: Speaker slide deadline: Tue COB. Please drop a PDF in this thread or in Drive under /talks/cloudstack.

maria_garcia: Swag update — we have 250 T-shirts, 150 stickers, 50 demo keycards. Shipping split: 150 to booth, 100 to partner sponsor booth. Need customs HS code for the keycards (small electronics).

partner_hw_contact: Keycards classified as HS8543 (magnetic stripe/similar). I'll add HS code to the manifest and resend to customs broker.

jess: Can we get a volunteer for stage handoff between the partner and Redwood speaker? We need immediate handoff script: 10s handoff, partner demo 4m, Redwood demo 6m.

kevin_ops: I'll take stage handoff and do the first partner intro. Also can staff the first booth shift 30-12:30.

maria_garcia: Thanks. Also need an audience CTA and a short signup link for the marketplace listing. Samir, can you produce a one-line CTA + URL for the slide footer?

samir: "Try our CloudStack connector — list it in your Cloud Console: rwd.co/cloudstack-try" — ok for footer?

maria_garcia: Good. Also, shipping contingency: if SILVA-VM-3 kit delayed, fallback = demo on cloud-only instances with same credentials. Ops doc updated with AMI IDs.

jess: Added AMI IDs and quick copy creds (read-only) to the secure notes. For demo QA, we need 3 test prompts that cover latency/batch behavior.

kevin_ops: I'll collate prompts and attach them to the runbook. Also tagging SRE on standby during show.

maria_garcia: Press & joint announcement: Legal needs 48h signoff on the co-branded copy. @partner_hw_contact please share the exact partner name + logo SVG by Mon.

partner_hw_contact: Uploaded partner_logo_silva.svg to Drive and shared with legal. Let me know if any format changes.

jess: One more ask — will there be power and network at the partner sponsor booth? We need 1x 20A circuit and wired ethernet. @events-team?

kevin_ops: Confirmed with events: sponsor booths get one 20A and 1Gbps wired uplink by default. If we need >1Gbps we need a paid upgrade.

maria_garcia: Awesome. Last: post-event follow-up plan: collect lead scans, schedule partner co-demo webinar in two weeks. I'll draft the follow-up email and share in #marketing.

samir: +1. Let's also capture a 3-min edited demo clip to drop on socials same day.

maria_garcia: Great — action items recap in Drive doc. If nothing else, final rehearsal Wed 10:00 ET. Please RSVP in the doc.
